subsystems.name: Battery pack
subsystems.role: stores energy in rechargeable lithium cells.

subsystems.name: Battery management system
subsystems.role: keeps every cell within safe voltage, current and temperature limits.

subsystems.name: Inverter and charger
subsystems.role: converts battery DC into mains AC, and charges the battery from a wall socket.

subsystems.name: Solar charge controller
subsystems.role: accepts DC from solar panels and charges the battery efficiently.

subsystems.name: DC outputs
subsystems.role: supplies 12 V, USB-A and USB-C for small devices.

subsystems.name: Enclosure and thermal management
subsystems.role: protects the electronics and removes heat.

subsystems.name: User interface
subsystems.role: shows state of charge and lets the user switch outputs.

buildSteps.title: Design the pack
buildSteps.detail: Choose cell chemistry, voltage and capacity to match the intended AC output power and runtime.

buildSteps.title: Assemble cells
buildSteps.detail: Cells are sorted, placed in holders, then connected with spot-welded nickel strips or bolted busbars.

buildSteps.title: Wire the BMS
buildSteps.detail: Sense leads are attached to each cell group, and the main negative and positive leads are routed through the BMS cutoff.

buildSteps.title: Build the power electronics
buildSteps.detail: Inverter, charger, MPPT and DC-DC boards are assembled and tested separately.

buildSteps.title: Fit into the enclosure
buildSteps.detail: The battery, circuit boards, fan, display and sockets are mounted in the case with insulation and strain relief.

buildSteps.title: Wire and test
buildSteps.detail: All connections are made, then continuity, insulation and basic function are checked.

buildSteps.title: Cycle and burn in
buildSteps.detail: The unit is charged and discharged several times to catch weak cells or overheating before shipping.

buildSteps.title: Certify and package
buildSteps.detail: Safety, electromagnetic compatibility and transport tests are completed, then the unit is boxed with cables.

pathway.milestone: portable stations with LiFePO4 cells, solar input and pure sine wave output
pathway.unlocks: reliable backup power for camping, emergencies and small off-grid systems.

pathway.milestone: higher capacity and faster charging in the same size
pathway.unlocks: longer runtime for medical devices, tools and appliances.

pathway.milestone: seamless integration with home energy management and rooftop solar
pathway.unlocks: a portable unit that also shaves peaks or backs up a house automatically.

pathway.milestone: solid-state or alternative chemistries with greater energy density
pathway.unlocks: lighter, smaller stations that can run heavier loads for longer.
